lines.heard: A dot swings across a screen 120 cm wide. X = A sin Nt. One oscillation takes 6 seconds.
lines.said: A dot swings across a screen one hundred and twenty centimetres wide: X equals A sine N T. One oscillation takes six seconds.

lines.heard: velocity is dxdt, and acceleration is d2xdt squared. So, we differentiate x once, then again.
lines.said: Velocity is D X D T, and acceleration is D two X D T squared. So we differentiate X once, then again.

lines.heard: First, what the question says. x = a sin nt
lines.said: First, what the question says. X equals A sine N T.

lines.heard: The screen is 120 cm wide. So AB is 120.
lines.said: The screen is one hundred and twenty centimetres wide, so A B is one hundred and twenty.

lines.heard: Oh is the center. So the dot swings 60 cm either side of O from A to B.
lines.said: O is the centre, so the dot swings sixty centimetres either side of O, from A to B.

lines.heard: For part A, sin always lies between -1 and 1.
lines.said: For part A: sine N T always lies between negative one and one.

lines.heard: Part B. Velocity is the rate of change of displacement. So V equals dxdt.
lines.said: Part B. Velocity is the rate of change of displacement, so V equals D X D T.

lines.heard: for the acceleration at A, we need sin pi t over three.
lines.said: For the acceleration at A, we need sine pi T over three there.

lines.heard: at A 60 sign pi T over 3 equals -60
lines.said: At A, sixty sine pi T over three equals negative sixty.
